title: People over trust AI-generated medical responses and view them to be as valid as doctors, despite low accuracy

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning randomized source labels ('Doctor', 'AI', 'Doctor assisted by AI') to medical responses to measure how the stated source influences non-experts' evaluations of trustworthiness and validity. Additionally, comparing blind versus non-blind evaluations by physicians to detect expert bias toward or against AI-generated text.
